In figure $ABCDEF$ shown above, which of the following equalities are true?

- $\overset{\to }{BC}-\overset{\to }{DC}=\overset{\to }{BD}$
- $\overset{\to }{BA}+\overset{\to }{AE}-\overset{\to }{FE}=\overset{\to }{BF}$
- $\overset{\to }{CD}-\overset{\to }{ED}-\overset{\to }{FE}=\overset{\to }{FC}$

In figure $ABCDEF$ shown above, which of the following equalities are true?

- $\overset{\to }{AB}-\overset{\to }{AF}=\overset{\to }{BF}$
- $\overset{\to }{DE}+\overset{\to }{EA}-\overset{\to }{BA}=\overset{\to }{DB}$
- $\overset{\to }{BE}-\overset{\to }{DE}-\overset{\to }{CD}=\overset{\to }{CB}$
feedback.worked_solution:
- Equality I is false. Indeed, 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB}-\overset{\to }{AF} & =\overset{\to }{AB}+\overset{\to }{FA} \\  & =\overset{\to }{FB} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{BF}.\end{aligned}
$$

- Equality II is true. Indeed, 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{DE}+\overset{\to }{EA}-\overset{\to }{BA} & =\overset{\to }{DE}+(\overset{\to }{EA}+\overset{\to }{AB}) \\  & =\overset{\to }{DE}+\overset{\to }{EB} \\  & =\overset{\to }{DB}.\end{aligned}
$$

- Equality III is false. Indeed,

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{BE}-\overset{\to }{DE}-\overset{\to }{CD} & =(\overset{\to }{BE}+\overset{\to }{ED})+\overset{\to }{DC} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BD}+\overset{\to }{DC} \\  & =\overset{\to }{BC} \\  & \ne \overset{\to }{CB}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the correct answer is "II only".
